lines.speaker: dimas
lines.text: Lots of new accounts sent PRs this week. Read every change carefully.

lines.speaker: dimas
lines.text: Final chapter: Secure Code. If code sends data to an unknown address, don't approve it. Escalate to Rani's SOC team.

lines.speaker: dimas
lines.text: There's also a flag trail in the logs. Follow it to the end.

lines.speaker: dimas
lines.text: The SOC team has blocked the 'helper-kode' account. Its code never got into our apps, thanks to your review.

lines.speaker: kelabu
lines.text: ...Our code got rejected again. What an annoying developer.

lines.speaker: dimas
lines.text: You're a real developer now. Drop by the Developer Desk again sometime!
